purpose: Teach: 下る/改める/件名/にせよ/借家/召集/所蔵/年頃

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 株価、本気で、下る、絶対、流れに、なってきていますね、社員、皆、本気で、頑張ろうね、絶対、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Our stock price is dropping, and it's becoming a real concern. Everyone, let's commit ourselves to this together — truly, we need to give it everything we have.
lines.style: Measured, slightly worried opening. Shift to rallying tone midway through. Steady pace building gentle firmness. Genuine appeal, not performative urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への対応、本気で、絶対、改めるべき部分、絶対、見直してまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I understand. We need to genuinely review how we're responding to customers — find what needs improvement and really commit to that. Thank you for holding us to that standard.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Nods slightly in the voice. Controlled pace, precise. Shows understanding first, then commitment. Genuine gratitude at the close, not formulaic.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: メールの件名、本気で、絶対、明確化していきましょうね、社内、効率化、本気で、進めましょう、絶対、本当に、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Let's make our email subject lines clearer — really nail that. And let's push forward with streamlining how we work internally. This matters, and we're going to do it together.
lines.style: Shift to directive mode. Lighter touch than the opening — this is actionable, not abstract worry. Clear enunciation on the key points. Confidence without harshness. Inclusive 'let's' carries warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。雨にせよ、本気で、お客様、絶対、ご来店、いただきます、本気で、店舗、頑張ります、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: Understood. Even when conditions are tough — rain or otherwise — our customers will still come, and we'll be ready for them. We'll show up for the store. Thank you for that reminder.
lines.style: Prompt, ready response. Small emphasis on 'even when' — acknowledgment of the difficulty. Settles into a calm, steady rhythm. The gratitude is genuine and grounded, not excessive.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人さん、借家暮らし、本気で、応援していきましょう、社員、皆、本気で、人生、絶対、応援、本当に、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: And the newer staff members — let's really look after them. Some of them are renting, working their way up, and we need to support them fully. Not just at work. Their whole journey.
lines.style: Softens here. Slower pace. Personal investment in the voice — this isn't a policy point, it's about people. Quiet conviction. Trailing emphasis on 'their whole journey' shows this matters beyond the office.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。緊急召集、本気で、対応できる体制、絶対、整えてまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、絶対、本気、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Absolutely. And we need to be ready if there's an emergency callout — I'll make sure we have the systems in place to respond quickly. We're prepared. Thank you for that trust.
lines.style: Alert, prepared tone. Brisk but not rushed. Shows immediate readiness. Gratitude comes through as acknowledgment of responsibility, not just politeness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会社の所蔵品、本気で、整理しないとね、絶対、貴重な、ものが、多いから、本気で、感謝、しないと、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: We need to organize our company's things properly. A lot of those items are valuable, irreplaceable — and we need to take care of them. Show respect for what we have.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly reflective. Pause before 'irreplaceable' — letting the weight settle. Slower tempo than the business directives. This is about stewardship, not efficiency. Quiet responsibility in every phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、年頃で、お祝い、続いておりますよ、本気で、社内、絶対、温かい雰囲気、感じます、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: That's wonderful. Our team keeps celebrating each other's milestones, and you can really feel it — there's warmth here. That matters more than people sometimes realize. It's something to be grateful for.
lines.style: Genuinely pleased, slightly surprised by the warmth. Softer, more intimate than directive mode. Lingers on the word 'warmth' — it's not just observed, it's felt. Close on a note of quiet appreciation.
